metadata.title: Sana — Heal, remember, recover.
metadata.description: A calm, bilingual companion that helps you track your injury, your bills, and your case after an accident.

landing.heroTitle: You got hurt. Sana helps you heal — and remember everything.
landing.heroSubtitle: Track your injury, your bills, and your case — in your language.

features.documentBody: Photos, bills, reports — kept in one place, organized for you.
features.recoveryBody: A simple daily check-in for pain, sleep, and how you feel.
features.caseTitle: Know what's happening with your case
features.caseBody: See where your claim stands, in plain language.
